scenes.scene_desc: He who sent down inner peace (Sakinah) into hearts: leaf on water
scenes.clip_desc: A crystal-clear, mirror-like natural forest pool in early morning. The water is so still it perfectly reflects the pine needles and sky above. A single olive leaf drops gently from a branch and settles onto the water surface tension without causing a splash—pure quietude.

scenes.scene_desc: Pleased with believers pledging under the sacred olive tree
scenes.clip_desc: Complete contrast to Scene 1: absolute stillness on a high rocky mountain ridge. A majestic, ancient gnarled olive tree with deep roots anchored directly into solid rock fractures. Silver-green canopy laden with ripe olives, motionless against an expansive clear blue sky.

scenes.scene_desc: Seedling putting forth shoot, growing thick and standing on stem
scenes.clip_desc: An exquisite Bird of Paradise (Cenderawasih) perched on a moss-covered branch in a misty rainforest, gently shifting its iridescent emerald crest and golden plumes in morning light.

scenes.scene_desc: Marks of prostration upon their faces, prayer mat in dawn stillness
scenes.clip_desc: Breathtaking panoramic coastal vista at dawn. In the far misty distance along the shoreline, the elegant silhouette of an ancient stone mosque and minaret stands quietly against the dawn. A small flock of sea birds soars freely across the pastel rose-and-sky-blue expanse, drifting toward the infinite horizon.

scenes.scene_desc: Verifying information with care, ancient manuscript on scholar desk
scenes.clip_desc: Open Qur'an on wooden desk with warm morning sunlight streaming across pages

scenes.scene_desc: Believers are brothers: peaceful shared marble courtyard with basin
scenes.clip_desc: Peaceful minimalist stone courtyard with reflective still water basin reflecting sky

scenes.scene_desc: Shunning suspicion and backbiting, quiet morning mist clearing
scenes.clip_desc: A natural woven palm-leaf prayer mat lies neatly rolled out upon the cool flagstones of an open stone veranda overlooking a misty morning valley. Soft golden sunlight spills across the floor, heralding peace.

scenes.scene_desc: Created nations and tribes to know each other, mountain pathway
scenes.clip_desc: An ancient stone pathway winding out of dark rugged mountain cliffs into an expansive, sun-drenched green valley. Above the valley, solitary white birds glide gracefully across an immense open morning sky (55% negative space).

scenes.scene_desc: Allah has bestowed favor by guiding you to faith, peaceful dawn arch
scenes.clip_desc: Symmetrical white marble colonnades and umbrellas of Masjid an-Nabawi basking in serene sunrise light. Pristine architectural stillness, zero humans visible.

scenes.scene_desc: Looking at the flawless cosmic canopy above, stars across expanse
scenes.clip_desc: Low-angle camera looking up into colossal, majestic white cumulus clouds drifting slowly across an infinite, tranquil azure sky. The sheer vastness of the clouds and negative space evokes the boundless expanse of Allah's forgiveness.

scenes.scene_desc: The earth spread out, anchored mountains, flourishing pairs of plants
scenes.clip_desc: An ancient gnarled olive tree rooted deep in rocky Mediterranean soil. Silvery-green leaves rustle smoothly in a warm mountain breeze. A symbol of enduring strength and ease embedded within struggle.

scenes.scene_desc: Blessed rain descending to yield rich gardens and towering trees
scenes.clip_desc: Macro tracking shot over deep green wild olive branches and rugged stone pathway as fresh gentle rain falls. Clear water droplets bead on leaves and drip onto rich dry earth, bringing immediate revival, glistening under breaking morning sunlight.

scenes.scene_desc: Closer to man than his jugular vein, quiet mountain stream in mist
scenes.clip_desc: Crystal clear mountain stream water flowing smoothly over mossy rounded river rocks

scenes.scene_desc: Glorify your Lord before sunrise and before setting, dawn sanctuary
scenes.clip_desc: Open Qur'an manuscript resting upon a dark hand-carved wooden rihal inside a peaceful stone arched portico. Outside, soft golden sunrise light washes over a serene valley of olive groves. A gentle breeze turns a single page.
